teacher: models_ai/<agent>_leg_confirm_rule.json: LegConfirmRule, 15m primary with the 5m candles inside (3 steps >= 1 ATR within 12 bars, 12h breakout, body and flow on its side, >= 2 strong 5m candles in the last two 15m bars), exit on the 4h structure
data: data/featured_data_causal_leg5m.parquet (2024-09-18 .. 2026-09-18), same split and embargo as the earlier runs
selection: cloud/train_guided.py picks on validation; holdout read once
approval: scripts/approve_agent_mirror.py criteria unchanged, with a minimum of 10 trades per block: the teacher trades about once a week per side and makes 12-18 trades in each 3.6-month block
disclosure: the teacher's validation and holdout results in the environment were displayed before this registration (bull +6.2%/+20.5%, bear +6.6%/-7.1%); the rule itself was selected on train only
